amends: results/predictions.json -> stage0.controls (the rules of down_only; down_last added; cfc_attn unchanged). predictions.json is not edited; every other filed setting and rule stands. Stage 0's other records (w0, band, e56, do_nothing) are read from predictions.json as filed.
reason: Job 52747 stopped at control down_only: d_n 0.4218 vs r_n 0.4250, missing the filed 'd_n > r_n'. Every exact check held (e_n 0, r_half = r_n, G 6.94). The rule was mis-specified: training the down_proj of every block changes the MLP input of every later block, so later neurons re-fire with W0's weights, and r_n counts that. 'd_n > r_n' is not implied by how the control is built.

Its r_n is recorded, not stopped on: it is the measured share that downstream re-firing caused by new write directions puts into r_n and r_half (job 52747: 0.425 of G). A 'blind to' reading.

down_last.rule: the last block's down_proj alone. By construction nothing downstream re-fires. If readable: |r_n|, |r_half|, |i_n| and |e_n| numerators are each <= band, and |d_n - 1| <= band / G. If not readable (|G| < gain_floor): log it and stop the job, the control has no teeth.
